Package com.agrialert.ui.alerts

Class AlertSettingsAdapter

java.lang.Object
androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.Adapter<AlertSettingsAdapter.AlertViewHolder>
com.agrialert.ui.alerts.AlertSettingsAdapter
public class AlertSettingsAdapter extends androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView.Adapter<AlertSettingsAdapter.AlertViewHolder>
Adapter for configuring alert settings in a RecyclerView. This adapter manages a list of AlertSettingUiModel and provides UI for toggling alerts and adjusting their threshold values.
